interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk to at least 6 feet to accommodate more users comfortably.

interventions.title: Install a Buffer Strip
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim back overhanging or encroaching vegetation to ensure the full width of the sidewalk is usable and sightlines are clear.

interventions.title: Marked Midblock Crossing with RRFB
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility crosswalk with advanced warning signs and Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons to improve driver awareness and yielding.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Maintain the sidewalk material and elevation across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority and encourage drivers to slow down.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffer
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and add a landscaped buffer or furniture zone to increase separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Buffered Sidewalk
interventions.description: Add a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and personal security along the walkway.

interventions.title: Add Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a planting strip or furniture zone between the curb and the sidewalk to provide physical separation from moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, increasing visibility.

interventions.title: Temporary Pedestrian Bypass
interventions.description: Provide a protected, ADA-compliant temporary walkway using water-filled barriers to maintain pedestrian continuity during construction.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implement a planting strip or furniture zone to provide a physical buffer between the sidewalk and high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk and Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a pedestrian refuge island to facilitate safe crossing, particularly for transit users.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing and Buffers
interventions.description: Reduce travel lane widths to slow traffic and use the reclaimed space to provide a planting buffer between the sidewalk and the road.
